name: YTPTube
description: YTPTube is a self-hosted web interface and download manager for yt-dlp. It queues URLs, playlists, channels and live streams, checks sources on a schedule, and adds reusable presets, notifications, a file browser and a built-in player.

notes.text: There is no default login: the first visitor creates the admin account, so open the web UI right after the install.

To keep downloads on a NAS or share them with Plex or Jellyfin, mount that folder at /opt/ytptube_data/downloads (pct set <CTID> -mp0 /host/path,mp=/opt/ytptube_data/downloads). The host folder must be writable by UID 100000.
To reset a password, stop ytptube and run: cd /opt/ytptube && YTP_CONFIG_PATH=/opt/ytptube_data/config .venv/bin/python -m app.scripts.reset_password --username <name>
